refactor: Simplify project data fetching

Remove the try/catch wrapper and error payload fallback from the projects page so fetch failures surface directly and the data loading path stays straightforward.

commit.message:
refactor: Move homepage components

Relocate homepage-only components into `src/components/homepage` and update the index page imports. `CommitLog` now fetches the commit list directly instead of wrapping the request with `safeAsync` and `ErrorOut`.
